ITEM.PTXT: A cup holder is provided in the front console box. The cup holder door is a push-open type that opens both front and rear, giving consideration to usability. In addition, removing the front/rear partition plate allows it to be used as a small article storage space, giving consideration to utility.
The rear console box has an increased height and a console door slide mechanism has been added, improving the armrest function.
The interior of the console box is divided into upper and lower levels, providing a structure with excellent storage capacity.
